summary: Independent Luna review of PR #1293 head 254513f3 remains NO-GO: managed-prefix inventory can ignore undeclared systemd entries, cleanup arguments do not match randomized handoff paths, descriptor reads are unbounded, and the /var/tmp handoff parent is not validated.
validation: Exact head 254513f33dda571e2c9d1a7e2d4a5dd8ffb2afbf reviewed against base efb9faac0606e02b7cac8e36e716f1ede9a50fb6.
Reviewer confirmed an outside-prefix systemd entry can be added to the synthetic snapshot while the complete verifier returns PASS.
Sudo cleanup argument and helper-emitted randomized handoff path were compared directly and are incompatible.
Guard and ARC classifier pass on the exact head; Validate and protected ARC producer remain queued.
blockers: Resolve managed-prefix inventory semantics: every security-relevant entry must be explicitly allowed or validated, while unrelated host services must not become accidental platform authority; add an outside-prefix regression test.
Replace the incompatible cleanup path contract with a safely constrained deterministic or argument-free cleanup interface and test emitted-to-cleanup path compatibility.
Bound every descriptor read by per-object maximum size and emit deterministic sanitized oversize evidence.
Validate /var/tmp or the selected handoff parent ownership, mode, and sticky-bit security before publication/cleanup; include it in the contract and tests.
next_action: Return to Luna code owner for loop-4 remediation and explicit security-scope reasoning, then independently re-review the new exact head.

issues.title: Managed-prefix inventory silently ignores outside-prefix systemd entries
issues.details: The verifier accepts an undeclared systemd entry outside managed prefixes; define and enforce the exact security-relevant inventory boundary without claiming unrelated host services.

issues.title: Cleanup sudo contract cannot address emitted randomized handoff path
issues.details: The sudo rule allows only the fixed handoff path while seal-handoff emits a randomized suffix and cleanup requires that randomized form.

issues.title: Descriptor reads lack size bounds
issues.details: Root-owned service, state, sudo, or helper files can cause unbounded memory consumption before validation produces evidence.

issues.title: Handoff parent security properties are not validated
issues.details: The helper opens /var/tmp without verifying root ownership, world-writable sticky protection, or replacement safety before publishing a root-owned handoff.
